general.name: Google Cloud IAP Connect [Mac] [Lin]
general.description: Installs the Google Cloud CLI and a desktop launcher that tunnels Remote Desktop to one VM through IAP; users sign in with Google on first use. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: gcpProject
variables.description: Required. GCP project id that owns the VM (lowercase, digits, hyphens).

variables.name: vmZone
variables.description: Required. Zone of the VM, e.g. us-central1-c.

variables.name: connectionLabel
variables.description: Name users see on the desktop shortcut. Letters, digits, space . _ - only.

variables.name: localPort
variables.description: Local listener port for the tunnel, 1024-65535.

variables.name: gcloudVersion
variables.description: Pin a Google Cloud CLI release, e.g. 540.0.0. Blank installs the latest.

variables.name: macPythonVersion
variables.description: macOS only. python.org release to install when no Python 3.10+ exists on the Mac (gcloud's installer needs one). Blank = 3.13.16.
